release_name: Live TV v5.6.1 (Build 70) — Default Favorites Channel Launch Release
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⭐ Default Favorites Channel Launch: The application now automatically opens directly in the Favorites channel section on launch across all 3 platforms (macOS, Android, and Web).
🪟 Native Multi-Window Experience: Open and watch unlimited independent floating windows simultaneously on macOS via ⌘N, Dock options, or in-app buttons.
👆 Click-to-Show Smart Player Controls: Moving the mouse cursor over the video no longer shows distracting quick buttons; click the video to toggle controls on/off. Configurable in Playback Settings.

⭐ Chronological Favorites Ordering: Starred channels are appended to the end of the favorites list so previously added favorite channels show first (#1, #2, ...), plus an Invert Order button in Rank Favorites.
✨ WebGL AI 4K Super-Resolution: Real-time hardware-accelerated EASU + RCAS upscaler up to native 4K 60fps.
⚡ Triple-Platform Release Pipeline: Automated build and signing for macOS DMG, Android Universal APK, and Web PWA.
